reason: It's hot in Honolulu and a bowl of ice-cold noodles near Ala Moana sounds just right, and Yu Chun turns up in the guides and blogs I read. At $18.95 it's a fair price for a vacation lunch, but I'm only here a week, so it's one visit, not a habit.
objection: I'm not sure black arrowroot noodles are really different from the naengmyeon I can get back home, and I'd hate to spend a vacation meal on something I could have had in my own city.
